description: This file defines templated classes for iterating over tiles of tensors in CUDA, specifically for residual last tiles in memory-efficient attention mechanisms. It includes specializations for pitch-linear, column-major, row-major, affine, and interleaved layouts, with predicate masking for out-of-bounds handling.

classes.name: PredicatedTileAccessIteratorResidualLast
classes.description: Templated iterator class for accessing residual tiles in various tensor layouts with predicate masking.

methods.name: set_iteration_index
methods.description: Sets the internal iteration index for the iterator.

methods.name: set_residual_tile
methods.description: Enables or disables residual tile masking.

methods.name: add_pointer_offset
methods.description: Adds a pointer offset in units of the element type.

methods.name: add_tile_offset
methods.description: Advances the iterator by a given tile offset.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current tile data.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next tile.

methods.name: set_mask
methods.description: Overrides the predicate mask with a given mask.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current access is valid based on predicates.
